text:
maria_cs: Quick check-in on Penumbra onboarding. They're seeing 320ms p50 but p95 spikes to 1.6s. Renewal in 2 months, want to reduce cost. Thinking: int8 quant + targeted routing to compact model for short prompts. Thoughts?

omar_se: Nice catch. Do we have their prompt length distribution? If most are <128 tokens int8 should help; numbers I've seen: int8 gave 1.8x throughput in similar app, ~30% cost save with minor quality impact.

riley_sre: Capacity note: dedicated pool only has 4 nodes in EU. If we increase batching we can drop p95 but latency risk. Suggest route split: 80% compact-int8 for short requests, 20% fp16 fallback for long/edge cases.

benchbot: Perf snapshot for model on eu-west:
```
model: redwood-compact-v2-int8
p50: 240ms
p95: 420ms
cost/unit: 0.7x
```

omar_se: For canary config:
```
route_rules:
 - match: req.tokens <= 128
   percent: 80
   model: redwood-compact-v2-int8
 - fallback: redwood-medium-v1-fp16
```
Start with 5k requests/day for 72h then evaluate.

li_devrel: I can prep the customer-facing doc + quick A/B prompts to monitor: quality checklist: hallucination rate, top-k token diff, user NPS. Will need a 6-8 prompt sample set. @maria_cs can you grab 20 representative prompts?

maria_cs: On it — will pull from sandbox and drop in shared drive by EOD. Also capturing customer sentiment tags.

sam_csm: Renewal flag: if we hit stable p95 < 600ms and show cost savings >20% we can present in renewal motion. Risk if we can't show results in 2 weeks.

omar_se: Also recommend adding kv-prefix caching for repeated prefixes. config snippet:
```
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl: 600s
```
That often cuts token compute for prompt-heavy templates.

riley_sre: Ops checklist: enable circuit-breaker to fallback to larger model if compact returns >3 errors/1m. I'll add to runbook.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Plan: run canary 72h | collect perf & quality | review on Tue sync. tagging ops @riley_sre @li_devrel

li_devrel: I'll schedule a 30m enablement with Penumbra engineers post-canary.

benchbot: Canary started 1753334600 — reporting in dashboard: https://rbwd.ai/bench/penumbra/1753334600 :rocket:

sam_csm: keeping stake on renewal deck. Ping me when we have first 24h numbers.

maria_cs: Will do — closing for now, will post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
